name: Men men
summary: The Hmong corn. Báo Sơn La, on 9 September 2025, says women in xã Co Mạ are expected to know how to mill mèn mén. A cooking method was not printed. Vietnamnet, on 16 March 2019, serves it with horse thắng cố on the Mộc Châu plateau and does not describe the corn.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 9 September 2025. Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019.
howToEat: With thắng cố, on the Vietnamnet account. A method, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Xã Co Mạ, on the milling line. The plateau bowl is Mộc Châu, in the Vietnamnet account.
seoTitle: Men men in Son La — Hmong corn, method not printed
seoDescription: Mèn mén in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La says Hmong women mill it. A cooking method was not printed. Vietnamnet serves it with thắng cố. Check on arrival.
